description: This file declares classes and functions related to rendering UI frames and dialogs in the confui module of the cuttlefish project. It includes class definitions for TeeUiFrameWrapper and ConfUiRenderer, along with their methods and dependencies.

classes.name: TeeUiFrameWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for managing a UI frame with specified width, height, and color, providing access to frame data and properties.

classes.name: ConfUiRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering UI dialogs and handling user interaction regions, utilizing a screen connector and internal implementation.

methods.name: TeeUiFrameWrapper(const int w, const int h, const teeui::Color color)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the frame with given dimensions and color.

methods.name: data()
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the frame data.

methods.name: Width() const
methods.description: Returns the width of the frame.

methods.name: Height() const
methods.description: Returns the height of the frame.

methods.name: IsEmpty() const
methods.description: Checks if the frame is empty.

methods.name: Size() const
methods.description: Returns the size of the frame.

methods.name: operator[](const int idx)
methods.description: Accesses a specific element in the frame.

methods.name: ScreenStrideBytes() const
methods.description: Calculates the stride in bytes for the screen.

methods.name: ConfUiRenderer(const ScreenConnectorFrameRenderer& screen_connector)
methods.description: Constructor injecting the screen connector dependency.

methods.name: RenderDialog(const std::uint32_t display_num, const std::string& prompt_text, const std::string& locale, const std::vector<teeui::UIOption>& ui_options)
methods.description: Renders a dialog with specified parameters.

methods.name: IsInConfirm(const std::uint32_t x, const std::uint32_t y)
methods.description: Checks if the point is within the confirm button area.

methods.name: IsInCancel(const std::uint32_t x, const std::uint32_t y)
methods.description: Checks if the point is within the cancel button area.

methods.name: IsInverted(const std::vector<teeui::UIOption>& ui_options) const
methods.description: Determines if the UI options specify an inverted display.

methods.name: IsMagnified(const std::vector<teeui::UIOption>& ui_options) const
methods.description: Determines if the UI options specify magnification.
